integrity: All finite calculations are exact; the all-size theorem uses a separate proof of marginal closure. The provenance and mathematical priority are not independently certified.
limitations: Only independent uniformly distributed circle endpoints, with arbitrary strictly positive coordinatewise edge activities. MTP2 failure does not imply failure of positive association. Previously published fine-grained enumeration could potentially imply the finite four-chord pattern counts.
title: Sharp FKG lattice threshold for random chord-crossing graphs
